title: Add a dispatch smoke test for every scheduled task
rationale: 1 scheduled task(s) import symbols that do not exist, so they fail on every dispatch. Nothing detects this because the app is not running.
current: scheduled jobs are only exercised in production.
proposal: add a test that imports every task module and asserts each task's callable resolves, plus a startup self-check in the worker entrypoint that exits non-zero on an unresolvable task.
benefit: a dead scheduled job fails CI in seconds instead of silently every night
